notes.title: This dev may be delusional
notes.content: Huge apologies to anyone stuck on floor 61 on a NG+. I could've sworn I'd put the reset code in for that floor and tested it, but as far as I can tell, that was all completely in my head. Anyone stuck there should be unstuck now.

notes.title: Monster art issues
notes.content:
Hey, just discovered some issues with the license terms for some of the monster art in the game (read: I'm a dumbass.) Unusable ones have been replaced, with related dialogue changes.

Also made it mandatory to visit the shopkeep the first time he's available, to solve continuity issues with doing that when party members aren't around.
